thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened a PR to update model cards for a couple quantized variants (orion-xl:int8, zephyr-mini:8bit). Need a quick sanity check on the limits table, benchmark entries, and the compatibility notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1347 :eyes:

leo: Thanks — I'll take a look today. Are those bench numbers from the new microbench infra or copied from the old run? We should mark the infra used in the table (GPU type, config).

maya: New run on our testing harness (a4g-4) with the latest runtime patch that toggles KV-prefetch off. Bench command is in the PR: ```scripts/run_bench.sh --model orion-xl --seq 1024 --batch 1 --config tests/infra/a4g-4.yaml``` Numbers are in the "throughput / tokens/s" column.

samira: Quick nit: the "Supported" section lists zephyr-mini under CPU quant, but we only validated 8-bit in server (daemon) mode — not the single-process dev path. Can we clarify that so customers don't try the unsupported local path?

maya: Good call. I'll add a sentence and link to the runtime compatibility matrix. Where's the canonical matrix?

elaine: It's at /docs/catalog/compatibility-matrix.md — you can link to it with relative path. Also please add the fallback note: "If INT8 variant is not available on target infra, runtime will automatically fall back to the float32 variant per routing policy."

leo: For the benchmark rows please include latency p95 and p99, plus the tokenization config (we use byte-level BPE with eod handling). Right now the table only shows avg tokens/s which is not enough for tail-sensitive apps.

maya: Will update table with p95/p99 and tokenization details. Also planning to add a short SDK snippet to show how to pin the quantized variant, e.g.: `client.generate({ model: "orion-xl:int8", input, max_tokens: 512 })`. Good idea?

samira: Yes include that. Also add a short guidance blurb that embeddings on quantized variants may show slight quality degradation (we measured ~2-3% drop in cosine on our eval set) — recommend float variants for production embedding accuracy.

docs-bot: Reminder — docs PRs must include a "tested-on" metadata block (OS/runtime/bench infra). See CONTRIBUTING.md for required keys.

maya: Added tested-on metadata, clarified CPU/server note for zephyr-mini, and pushed two commits. I also added the p95/p99 columns and the SDK snippet in examples.md.

leo: Quick review done — left two small wording comments about the compatibility note and the fallback phrasing. Bench numbers look consistent with the a4g-4 run. Approving once CI finishes.

samira: Approved from docs/QA side. Thanks for addressing the server-mode callout.

maya: Thanks everyone — merging after CI passes. Will follow up with a short toot on the docs changelog and add a link to the runtime-compat matrix in the model-card header. :rocket:
